text: Gardening is a rewarding activity that not only brings beauty to our surroundings, but also provides numerous health and environmental benefits. One of the most important aspects of gardening is preparing the soil. This process involves creating a rich and fertile environment for plants to thrive by adding organic matter like compost. Composting adds essential nutrients, improves soil structure, and enhances its water-holding capacity. By using mulch, gardeners can further conserve water and reduce weed growth. Mulch acts as a protective layer, shielding the soil from extreme temperatures and preventing moisture loss. This simple yet effective approach can significantly improve the overall health and productivity of the garden. Moreover, gardening not only beautifies our living spaces but also fosters a deeper connection with nature, promoting a sense of well-being and sustainability.
summary: Gardening involves preparing soil with compost for plants, using mulch for water conservation and weed suppression.
